messages:
mira: Quick follow-up from the admit-gateway sync: propose a compact 'unified-capability' descriptor that both bench and validator consume. keep it tiny and evolution-friendly. thoughts?

jon: sounds reasonable. router stays separate. descriptor = capabilities + small hints only.

sam: required for smoke: tokenizer_id, tokenizer_checksum, binary_hash, dtype, kv_enabled, p50/p90 seqlen, canonical_prefixes.

claudia: bench wants optional sample_seqs pointer (signed url/artifact id) and a small immutability flag. size limit <4KB.

jon: add schema_version and a deprecated_fields list for migration. runtime should ignore unknown fields.

zach: ops: ensure descriptor is indexable by token-checksum + binary_hash. weekly scans must be cheap.

sam: caching: key smoke results by (tokenizer_checksum,binary_hash,descriptor_version).

claudia: propose two admit levels: smoke (sync, <2s) using canonical prefixes, deep (async) using golden evals.

mira: fallback: if smoke fails but binary_hash matches previously approved artifact -> allow limited canary with stricter monitoring. new binary_hash -> block.

jon: about tokenizer_checksum: use sha256 over tokens of N golden utterances (50) to catch tokenization drift.

sam: lint step in intake to enforce required fields + defaults and size limit. will prototype next week.

mira: action items: mira draft schema v0.1 by Tue; jon add tokenizer-checksum lib; sam add lint; claudia write smoke/deep defs; zach confirm registry index.

ops-bot: task created: ADMIT-GW-210 (owner: sam) | due: 2026-04-08

mira: thanks, i'll post the YAML in eng-ml-docs when ready.
